title: Without See Financial Data the price and Priced by are hidden
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit', 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A, priced by a new matrix for this test, matrix A, with one cost range ($0.00 and up) whose Default rule is Markup % 35.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses, whose column in matrix A is % Off 10.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, put on tier A for work orders in Edit Customer.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, made after customer A's tier was set, with one labor line (line 1), with a tier-priced part and a part with a typed price on line 1, added by an Admin.
  • Have a second user for this test whose role has 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit' but not 'See Financial Data'.
  • Sign in as that second user in a separate browser window.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens with both parts listed by description and quantity.
  • No sell price, margin or Manual icon shows on either part.

Step 2:

  • The Parts tab lists both parts by description and quantity.
  • No Priced by column shows.
  • Pointing at a part shows no price details.
